narrative: Material PL3__MC6DA11C shows erratic demand (CV=0.627) over 228 working days with no measurable trend, and unstable supplier lead times ranging from 0.8 to 3.43 days (CV=0.52). The current SAP policy carries zero safety stock, leaving the material unprotected against combined demand and lead-time variability. An (r,Q) continuous-review policy with safety stock of 1,822 units and order quantity of 19,195 units achieves the 95% service level target while reducing total annual inventory costs by 39.3% through fewer, larger replenishment orders.

research_insights.selection_rationale: The material has continuous (non-intermittent) albeit erratic demand with a non-zero fraction of 79%. A continuous-review (r,Q) policy is appropriate because it triggers replenishment as soon as stock falls to the reorder point, providing responsive protection against the observed lead-time instability without requiring fixed-interval reviews.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity is not binding. Peak inventory (safety stock + order quantity = 21,017) is well below the 45,440-unit storage limit, so no capacity-driven order reduction is required.
